z-m-24-01.title: Hal sadar oo xalka ah ayaa tirtiray xal
z-m-24-01.topic: Xalalka lumaya marka labada dhinac ee isla'eg loo qaybiyo isla tibaax
z-m-24-01.goal: Hel sadarka xalka halka xal ku lumay, guud ka dhig shuruudaha isla'egyada halkan ay ku dhacdo, oo samee isla'egyo adigu oo lumiya xal oo sharax sababta.
z-m-24-01.material: Jia wuxuu xalliyay isla'egta x³ = 4x wuxuuna qoray "xalalku waa 2 iyo −2, laba oo ka mid ah". Doyun wuxuu eegay xalka Jia wuxuuna yiri oo keliya inuu ka duwan yahay jawaabtiisa, isagoo aan sabab bixin. Hawshan, dhammaan x waa tirooyin dhab ah. (x³ waxaa loo akhriyaa "x saddex-jibbaar" x²-na waxaa loo akhriyaa "x labajibbaaran".)
z-m-24-01.thinking.0: Helidda halka khaladku ku jiro xal
z-m-24-01.thinking.1: Go'aaminta shuruudaha hoostooda beddelidda tibaax ay beddesho kooxda xalalka
z-m-24-01.thinking.2: Samaynta tusaalayaal lid ku ah (isla'egyo lumiya xal) adigu
z-m-24-01.prereq.0: H2 ee kooxdan waa qaybin adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada ma aha fasalka dugsiga lagu bara. Kala horreynta dugsiga la malaynayo: waxaad ku barateen dugsiga dhexe sida loo xalliyo isla'egyada labajibbaaran adoo qodob-qodobayn isticmaalaya, waxaadna kula kulantay qodob-qodobaynta tibaaxaha saddex-jibbaarka ah Xisaabta Guud.
z-m-24-01.prereq.1: Hab lagu geliyo qiime isla'eg si loo hubiyo haddii labada dhinac le'eg yihiin
z-m-24-01.prereq.2: Dhammaan x hawshan waa tirooyin dhab ah.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Kani waa xalka Jia. Dooro sadarka xalka ka dhigay mid khaldan, ama sadarka khaladkaasi sida uu yahay uga muuqdo.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta, mid mid hubi "ma isla'eg leh isla xalalka sadarka ka hor?"
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Geli 0, 2, −2 halkii x si isku xigta oo hubi haddii isla'egta asalka ah x³ = 4x ay sax tahay.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.0: Xalli x³ = 4x. (x waa tiro dhab ah)
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.1: Qaybinta labada dhinac x waxay bixisaa x² = 4.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed xalalka isla'egtan waa 2 iyo −2, laba oo ka mid ah.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 2 waxaan u qaybinnay x, laakiin haddii aad x = 0 gelisid isla'egta asalka ah, labada dhinacba waa 0, sidaas darteed way sax tahay. Xaaladda x = 0 si gooni ah ma la eegin, sidaas darteed xalka 0 waa la seegay, natiijaduna waxay keentay "laba" ee sadarka 5. Sadarrada 3 iyo 4 si sax ah ayay u xalliyeen isla'egta ka dib qaybinta. Xalalka dhabta ah ee isla'egta asalka ah waa saddexda, −2, 0, 2.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Dhammaan isla'egyada hoose waxaa lagu xalliyaa tirooyinka dhabta ah. Kee ayaan lumin midna xalalka isla'egta asalka ah xataa haddii aad labada dhinac u qaybiso tibaaxda qaubka ama sharaxaadda ku jirta oo aad xalliso isla'egta hadhay oo keliya?
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isla'eg kasta, raadi haddii ay jirto qiime x ah oo ka dhigaysa tibaaxda aad rabto inaad u qaybiso le'eg 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Geli qiyamka aad heshay labada dhinac ee isla'egta asalka ah, oo sidoo kale eeg haddii ay jirto isla'eg aan lahayn tiro dhab ah oo sidaas ah gabi ahaanba.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.a: Tani waa doorasho aan hubin waxa ku dhaca labada dhinac marka qiimaha ka dhigaya x − 2 le'eg 0 la geliyo isla'egta asalka ah.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad seegtay in qiimaha ka dhigaya qaybiyaha 0 uu noqon karo xalka isla'egta asalka ah. Geli x = 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.c: Tani waa doorasho lagu xalliyay iyadoo la isticmaalayo halbeeg ah haddii ay jirto tiro dhab ah oo ka dhigaysa qaybiyaha 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.d: Xataa haddii ay jirto labajibbaare, qiimaha x − 1 ay tahay 0, labada dhinacba waa 0. Hubi haddii qiimahaasi yahay xal.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Haddii labada dhinac ay leeyihiin qaabka f·g = f·h, qiime f uu yahay 0 had iyo jeer waa xal. Sidaas darteed haddii ay jirto tiro dhab ah f uu yahay 0, waa inaad qiimahaas si gooni ah u daryaantaa ka hor qaybinta. x² + 3 waa ugu yaraan 3 tiro dhab ah kasta, sidaas darteed weligeed ma aha 0, c-na xal (x = 4) ma lumiso qaybinta. Haddii xadka loo balaadhiyo tirooyinka isku-dhafan, xalalka x² + 3 = 0 waa inay sidoo kale la tixgeliyaan, sidaas darteed xaaladdu way ka duwan tahay.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.prompt: Samee 3 isla'eg oo kala duwan oo qaabka (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a). a, b, c waa tirooyin dhan oo ka bilaabma −9 ilaa 9 c-na ≠ 0. Ka dhig xalka qaybinta labada dhinac x − a mid lumiya hal xal, xalka lumay a taban iyo xalka b + c ee ka dib qaybinta la helay togan.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore dooro a inuu noqdo taban, ka dibna isku day beddelidda b iyo c si b + c uu u noqdo togan.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi waxa dhaca marka aad x = a gelisid labada dhinac ee isla'egta aad samaysay.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c5: Xalka b + c ee ka dib qaybinta la helay waa togan.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.explain: Tusaale ahaan, haddii a = −3, b = 1, c = 2, markaas (x + 3)(x − 1) = 2(x + 3). U qaybinta x + 3 waxay bixisaa x = 3 oo keliya, laakiin x = −3 sidoo kale waxay ka dhigtaa labada dhinac 0, sidaas darteed waa xal. U wareejinta wax walba hal dhinac waxay bixisaa (x + 3)(x − 3) = 0, sidaas darteed xalalku waa labada, −3 iyo 3. Isla'egyada xalkooda a iyo xalka b + c ee ka dib qaybinta la helay isku mid yihiin waxay tirsamaan mid, sidaas darteed haddii labadan ay kala duwan yihiin, waa isla'egyo kala duwan.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.prompt: Dooro mid ka mid ah isla'egyada aad samaysay oo qor xalka (lambarro) kee ayaa lumaya marka labada dhinac loo qaybiyo x − a, iyo sababta.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.0: Xisaabi waxa dhinac kasta noqdo marka aad x = a gelisid isla'egta aad samaysay.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.1: Is barbar dhig isbarbar xalka lagu helay tibaaxda ka dib qaybinta iyo xalka lagu helay u wareejinta wax walba hal dhinac.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ma ku hubisay lambarrada tusaalahaaga in gelinta xalka lumaya isla'egta asalka ah ay ka dhigto labada dhinac le'eg?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay sababta "qiimaha ka dhigaya qaybiyaha 0" erayadaada?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Ma ka fikirtay ugu yaraan hal hab oo lagu helo dhammaan xalalka adigoon qaybin (tusaale, u wareejinta wax walba hal dhinac oo ka dhigidda wax-soo-saar)?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.0: Tibaaxda aan samaystay waa (x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Haddii aan u qaybiyo x+3, x=3 oo keliya ayaa hadha, laakiin haddii aan geliyo x=−3, labada dhinacba waa 0, sidaas darteed −3 sidoo kale waa xal. Waa qiimaha ka dhigaya qaybiyaha 0, sidaas darteed xalka waa lumay.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.1: (x+1)(x−4)=−1(x+1), u qaybinta x+1 waxay bixisaa x−4=−1 oo keliya, taasoo ah x=3. Laakiin haddii x=−1, x+1 waa 0 labada dhinacna way le'eg yihiin, sidaas darteed −1 sidoo kale waa xal, wuxuuna lumaa sababtoo ah waxay la mid tahay qaybinta 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Waa sidoo kale fiican tahay inay marka hore sheegtay xalka lagu helay ka dib qaybinta ka dibna sheegtay xalka lumay.

z-m-24-02.title: Imisa xal ayaa dhibaato aan lahayn xad leh?
z-m-24-02.topic: Tirada xalalka isla'egta saddex-jibbaarka ah x³ = 1 iyo xadka tirooyinka
z-m-24-02.goal: Ogow xalku xad tiro noocee ah ayuu u malaynayaa, ilaali ama dib u eeg go'aankaaga ku saabsan tirada xalalka mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub yimaado, oo xaqiiji jawaab ku xiran xadka iyo xalalka aad adigu heshay.
z-m-24-02.material: Waxaa jirta dhibaato helista xalalka isla'egta x³ = 1. Xadka x lagama qorin dhibaatada. Minsu wuxuu qoray xal is barbar dhigaya cabbirrada, Seoyun, oo arkay xalka, ayaa weydiiyay, "Miyaanan marka hore go'aaminnin xadka?" Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid, sidaas darteed adigu go'aami go'aankaaga mar kasta. (x³ waxaa loo akhriyaa "x saddex-jibbaar".)
z-m-24-02.thinking.0: Sheegidda xadka (shuruudda) halka doodda ku sax tahay
z-m-24-02.thinking.1: Dib u eegista ama sii haynta go'aan macluumaad cusub
z-m-24-02.thinking.3: Helidda dhowr xal adigu iyo xaqiijinta
z-m-24-02.prereq.0: H2 ee kooxdan waa qaybin adkaanta iyo heerka taageerada ma aha fasalka dugsiga lagu bara. Kala horreynta dugsiga la malaynayo: horeyba waxaad ku barateen Xisaabta Guud macnaha tirooyinka isku-dhafan (cutubka mala-awaalka i, i² = −1) iyo dhufashadooda, kala saaraha isla'egyada labajibbaaran, iyo qodob-qodobaynta tibaaxaha saddex-jibbaarka ah.
z-m-24-02.prereq.1: Shuruudda laba tiro oo isku-dhafan ay le'eg yihiin: qaybaha dhabta ah midba midka kale way le'eg yihiin, qaybaha mala-awaalka ah-na midba midka kale way le'eg yihiin.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid. Mar kasta, dooro go'aan oo eeg haddii macluumaadka cusub beddelo ama ilaaliyo go'aanka.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo baxo, dib u akhri doorashada aad hore u samaysay oo hal sadar ku qor waxa isbeddelay.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka hor doorashada ikhtiyaar, marka hore eeg "xad tiro noocee ah" doorashadaas ay u malaynayso.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Kani waa dhibaato xallinta isla'egta x³ = 1. Xadka x lagama qorin dhibaatada. Xalka Minsu: "x = 1 waa xal. Haddii x > 1 markaas x³ > 1, haddii x < 1 markaas x³ < 1, sidaas darteed xalka keliya waa x = 1." ('>' waxaa loo akhriyaa "ka weyn" '<' na waxaa loo akhriyaa "ka yar".)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii x yahay tiro dhab ah, doodda Minsu waa sax (haddii ay ka weyn tahay 1, x³ > 1, haddii ay ka yar tahay, x³ < 1). Laakiin xadka lagama qorin, sidaas darteed weli ma ogaan karno haddii ay ku filan tahay in kaliya tirooyinka dhabta ah la tixgeliyo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Dhammaan tirooyinka waa la is barbar dhigi karaa cabbir, sidaas darteed xalka Minsu waa sax xalka keliya-na waa 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ma tixgelin haddii dhammaan tirooyinka loo kala horreyn karo ka weyn iyo ka yar. Ka fikir tirooyinka noocee ah ayaa cabbir ahaan la is barbar dhigi karaa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Xalku waa sax marka x yahay tiro dhab ah. Laakiin xad ma jiro, sidaas darteed hubin dheeraad ah ayaa loo baahan yahay
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad akhridday tirooyinka xalku u malaynayo, oo sidoo kale ku darteen go'aankaaga in xadku maqan yahay.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Isla'eg saddex-jibbaar ah waa inay leedahay saddex xal, sidaas darteed xal sheegaya hal waa khalad
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad ku sheegtay tirada xalalka darajada oo keliya. Imisa xal oo kala duwan ayaa jira waa in lagu hubiyaa adoo eegaya tibaaxda iyo xadka.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Waxaad geliday x = 1 oo keliya, sidaas darteed wax kama ogaan karo xalkan
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Xalku wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay qayb tixgelinaysa xaaladaha ka weyn 1 iyo ka yar 1. Akhri waxa qaybtaasi dammaanad qaadayso.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Laba macluumaad oo cusub ayaa soo baxay. (1) x³ − 1 = (x − 1)(x² + x + 1), kala saaraha isla'egta labajibbaaran x² + x + 1 = 0 na waa 1 − 4 = −3. (2) Sharaxaadda hore ee buugga dhibaatooyinkan waxay leedahay "cutubkan, isla'egyada waxaa lagu xalliyaa tirooyinka isku-dhafan", laakiin dhibaatadan lafteedu weli xad ma laha.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda sidee u jawaabi lahayd "imisa xal oo kala duwan ayaa jira"?
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: x − 1 = 0 ka xalka dhabta ah 1 ayaa soo baxa, x² + x + 1 = 0 na wuxuu leeyahay kala saare taban, sidaas darteed xal dhab ah ma laha oo wuxuu leeyahay laba xal oo kala duwan oo mala-awaal ah. Haddii dhab, 1 xal; haddii isku-dhafan, 3 xal. Maadaama xadka aan la go'aamin, labadaba ku jawaabida xad ahaan, ama qorista malo-awaalka ku saleysan sharaxaadda cutubka iyo ku jawaabidda 3, waa macquul. Go'aanka Minsu "tirooyinka dhabta ah waxaa jira hal xal" wuxuu sii jiraa sida uu yahay.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dhibaatada xad ma laha, sidaas darteed ka fikir tirooyinka dhabta ah oo keliya oo ku jawaab oo keliya in xalku yahay 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waa sax sidii jawaab xadka tirooyinka dhabta ah, laakiin ma isticmaalin macluumaadka cusub, xisaabta kala saaraha iyo sharaxaadda cutubka, go'aankaaga.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kala saaraha waa −3, taasoo taban, sidaas darteed isla'egtani xal ma laha xad tiro kasta
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kala saaraha waa macluumaad ku saabsan hal qodob x² + x + 1. Waxaad ilowday in uu jiro qodob kale, x − 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: U jawaab adoo xadka kala qaybinaya: 1 xal haddii dhab, 3 xal haddii isku-dhafan
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad xaqiiqda ah in xadka aan la go'aamin ku dartay jawaabta sida ay tahay. Go'aankani wuxuu muujinayaa in jawaabtu ku xiran tahay shuruudaha.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Raac sharaxaadda cutubka, u daawo sidii isku-dhafan oo qor 3, adoo sheegaya malo-awaalka
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Waxaad isticmaashay tilmaanta sharaxaadda cutubka oo sheegtay malo-awaalka. Go'aankani wuxuu qoray labadaba aasaaska iyo xadka.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: U yeedh hal xidid mala-awaal ah ω = (−1 + √3 i)/2. (i waa cutubka mala-awaalka oo leh i² = −1, tibaaxdana waxaa loo akhriyaa "laga jar 1 oo lagu daray xidid 3 i, wadarta 2 u qaybi".) Waxaan ognahay in ω uu yahay xidid x² + x + 1 = 0. Waxaan rabnaa inaan si toos ah u hubinno haddii ω-kan runtii uu sidoo kale buuxiyo x³ = 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hababka hubinta kuwee ayaa sax ah? (Waxaa jiri kara dhowr hab.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Labada hab labaduba waa hubin saxan. a wuxuu isticmaalaa ω² + ω + 1 = 0 oo keliya, c-na wuxuu si toos ah u helaa ω² oo ku dhufaa. Qiime qiyaas ah (b) waa hubin kaliya oo qabata khaladaadka xisaabta mana aha xaqiijin, d-na wuxuu horay u malaynayaa gabagabada. Maadaama xididka mala-awaalka sidoo kale uu sidaas u buuxiyo x³ = 1, go'aankii hore ee ahaa 3 xal oo ka jira tirooyinka isku-dhafan waa la taageeray.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Isticmaal ω² = −ω − 1 si aad u xisaabiso ω³ = ω·ω² = −ω² − ω = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad dooratay habka lagu hoos u dhigo ω³ tibaax toosan oo ω ah adigoo isticmaalaya tibaax aad horeyba u taqaanid.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Qor ω sida −0.5 + 0.87i, ku dhufo dhowr jeer, oo tixgeli in la hubiyay haddii ay 1 ku dhow tahay
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Xisaabinta qiyamo qiyaas ah waxay caawisaa hubin ahaan, laakiin ma xaqiijiso inay si sax ah tahay 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hel ω² oo ku dhufo ω si aad u hubiso (−1+√3 i)(−1−√3 i)/4 = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad dooratay habka lagu hubiyo ku dhufasho toos ah. Furaha waa sida qaybta mala-awaalka u baxdo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Maadaama ω uu yahay xidid isla'eg ah, ka tixgeli ω³ = 1 inay horeyba sax tahay oo isticmaal sida ay tahay
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxaad u qaadatay gabagabada aad rabto inaad hubiso inay horeyba run tahay. Isla'egta ω uu xidid u yahay waa x² + x + 1 = 0, ma aha x³ = 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Haddii aad marka hore u malaysay "xalka keliya waa 1", macluumaadkee ayaa u cidhiidhiyay go'aankaas "sax tirooyinka dhabta ah"? Maxay doodda is barbar dhigaysa cabbirrada u isticmaali karin tirooyinka mala-awaalka?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka soo qaad tiro isku-dhafan z = a + bi (a, b waa tirooyin dhab ah) oo buuxisa z³ = 1. Maadaama (a + bi)³ = (a³ − 3ab²) + (3a²b − b³)i, qaybta dhabta ah a³ − 3ab² waa inay noqotaa 1 qaybta mala-awaalka 3a²b − b³ na waa inay noqotaa 0. Geli 3 xal oo kala duwan sida (a, b). Tirooyinka aan saami ahayn waa la qori karaa oo la wareegi karaa laba meelood oo jajab ah, khalad gudaha 0.02 ayaa la aqbalaa.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi waxa x³ − 1 noqdo marka aad z = 1 gelisid, oo hel xididdada tibaaxda labajibbaaran ee hadhay x² + x + 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Geli qaybta dhabta ah ee xididka aad heshay a, tirada hor taal i-na geli b, oo xisaabi haddii labada tibaax ay u dhow yihiin 1 iyo 0, siday u kala horreeyaan.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Qaybta dhabta ah waxay waafaqsan tahay 1 (khalad gudaha 0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Qaybta dhabta ah a³ − 3ab² ee (a + bi)³ ma aha 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Qaybta mala-awaalka waxay waafaqsan tahay 0 (khalad gudaha 0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Qaybta mala-awaalka 3a²b − b³ ee (a + bi)³ ma aha 0.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Xalalku waa saddexda, z = 1, z = (−1 + √3 i)/2, z = (−1 − √3 i)/2. Sida jajabyo waa qiyaastii (1, 0), (−0.5, 0.87), (−0.5, −0.87).
